content: Node token best practice: crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('base64url') for a 256-bit token, prefix segment (e.g. sc_live_) taken from the raw token before hashing and stored as its own column, crypto.createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex') stored as the lookup hash. Since the hash is 256 bits of entropy already, a lookup (not bcrypt/PBKDF2) is appropriate, matching a WHERE token_sha256 =  query with no timing-safe compare needed.
